caption:
अरे भाई! क्या आपको पता है कि ब्लॉकबस्टर फिल्म Main Hoon Na के वक्त श्वेता घोषाल को लेकर इंडस्ट्री में क्या बवाल मचा था? 🎤

फिल्ममेकर फराह खान ने अपने व्लॉग में खुलासा किया है कि जब 2004 की इस फिल्म के लिए गाने रिकॉर्ड हो रहे थे, तब श्वेता एक नई newcomer थीं।
फराह का कहना है कि इंडस्ट्री के कई लोगों ने उन्हें सलाह दी थी कि वो इतनी कम उम्र की नई सिंगर के साथ काम न करें और उनकी काबिलियत पर सवाल उठाए थे।
लेकिन फराह खान और म्यूजिक कंपोज़र अनु मलिक को श्वेता के टैलेंट पर पूरा भरोसा था और उन्होंने उन्हें फिल्म में मौका दिया।
श्वेता ने बताया कि सुष्मिता सेन को स्क्रीन पर देखकर वह सोच रही थीं कि उन्होंने गानों के साथ इंसाफ किया है या नहीं।
फराह ने खुलासा किया कि पहले उन्हें अमृता राव वाला छोटा हिस्सा गवाया गया और फिर उनकी आवाज़ सुनने के बाद सुष्मिता सेन वाला ट्रैक दिया गया।
लोगों ने फराह को फोन करके कहा था कि वो नई लड़की को लेकर बहुत बड़ी गलती कर रही हैं, लेकिन फराह फ्रेश आवाज़ चाहती थीं। 🎬

क्या आपको Main Hoon Na के गाने आज भी उतने ही पसंद हैं? 💬

ctx.title: Farah Khan admits film industry insiders were unsure of Shreya Ghoshal for Main Hoon Na songs
ctx.summary: Shreya Ghoshal was just 18 and the songs of Devdas had not released yet. Still, Farah Khan gave her the opportunity to sing in her film.
ctx.text:
Singer Shreya Ghoshal has sung some of the most melodious songs in Bollywood over the last two decades. The singer won her first National Award as a playback singer for her debut with Devdas itself, at a very young age. Filmmaker and YouTuber Farah Khan visited Shreya's Mumbai residence for her latest vlog, where they chatted about their long correspondence, which began with the release of Main Hoon Na. The 2004 release also included songs sung by Shreya.
But at the time the songs were being recorded for the Shah Rukh Khan-starrer, Shreya was a brand-newcomer, and her songs from Devdas weren't released. Farah and Shreya recalled memories from that time during their conversation. Farah revealed that several people from the film industry had even told her not to work with such a young singer, questioning her ability to pull off the songs. But Farah, as well as music composer Anu Malik, firmly believed in Shreya’s talent and went ahead with her.
Shreya shared, “When I saw Sushmita on screen… how beautiful she looked, and I was wondering whether I had done justice to the songs.” Farah added, “You sang Main Hoon Na (title track) also very well, that little portion for Amrita Rao… and after hearing that, we gave you the Sushmita track in the film. So many people called me and asked why I was taking this new girl, that I was making a big mistake! But I said that I wanted a fresh voice.”
Shreya Ghoshal sang two tracks for the 2004 Bollywood film Main Hoon Na, composed by Anu Malik with lyrics by Javed Akhtar. They were the title track, and the song Tumhe Jo Maine Dekha.
Main Hoon Na, released in 2004, marked Farah Khan’s directorial debut and starred Shah Rukh Khan, Sushmita Sen, Suniel Shetty, Amrita Rao and Zayed Khan. The film follows Major Ram, who goes undercover as a college student while working on a military mission. Alongside its action and romance, the film also focuses on family relationships and Ram’s bond with his half-brother Lakshman. It became a commercial success and remains one of the popular Hindi films of the 2000s.
